purpose: Provide a strengthened, non-circular, current-authority synthesis for the dialogue's Fallout/Janus/identity/witness/birthday/atomic/UAP lines. The synthesis connects domains only with typed edges and never upgrades a weaker layer merely because a stronger neighboring layer exists.

epistemic_edge_labels.FACT: Directly source-bound shipped record, primary measurement, or externally established fact in its own domain.
epistemic_edge_labels.INTERPRETATION: Bounded explanatory reading or scientific interpretation; not a separate observation.
epistemic_edge_labels.ANALOGY: Structural similarity across domains with explicit non-identity.
epistemic_edge_labels.OPEN_HYPOTHESIS: Concrete falsifiable candidate requiring a new observation or experiment.
epistemic_edge_labels.TEST: Methodological connection where one layer supplies a falsification/control method for another.
epistemic_edge_labels.NEGATIVE: A source-bound absence/failure that constrains promotion.

L0_SOURCE_AND_PROVENANCE.label: source bytes / exact records / external literature
L0_SOURCE_AND_PROVENANCE.rule: No higher layer may manufacture facts missing here.

L1_CHILD_THRESHOLD.label: children, thresholds, protection, refusal, survival
L1_CHILD_THRESHOLD.current_reading: Little Lamplight/Vault87 and related child-threshold artifacts support recurring boundary/protection themes; protective intent is not automatically proven by protective effect.

L2_WITNESS_OBJECTS.label: teddy/gnome/skeleton staged visual language
L2_WITNESS_OBJECTS.current_reading: Teddy can function as child/comfort/trust/absence/witness; gnome can function as miniature actor/observer/arranger/authorial wink. Local staged scenes are real. A universal game-wide death grammar requires full effective-REFR measurement.

L3_IDENTITY_SOVEREIGNTY.label: A3-21/Harkness, memory replacement/recovery, affected-party authority
L3_IDENTITY_SOVEREIGNTY.current_reading: The game supplies a strong identity transition/recovery case and an ethical constraint: technical capacity to overwrite memory does not imply authority to erase an existing person.

L4_JANUS_BEAR_PRODUCT.label: child-facing local AI guardian/witness
L4_JANUS_BEAR_PRODUCT.current_reading: Fallout scenes act as contrast/inspiration: the teddy beside remains is the witness after protection failed; Janus Bear is designed to intervene earlier through nonviolent, privacy-visible, child-agency-preserving support.

L5_SAVE_JAMES.label: James-specific source -> identity graph -> possible persisted memory -> carrier -> compatible host
primary_facts: Vault112a/James pod endpoint and persistent pod/shell refs are primary-ESM bound.
MQDadRef and MQ04Doc are bound through the MQ04 quest identity graph.
DadInfo/DadDogInfo are identity/discovery metadata, not autobiographical memory payload.
Pinkerton primary text establishes a pre-populated physical memory carrier class and successful memory import into an android.
No separate technical mem-chip item FormID or separate neuralizer world object was found in the reviewed ESM search.
Pinkerton theft is 2276 while James's Vault112 session is 2277.

L6_BIRTHDAY_IDENTITY.label: CG02 birthday poem / rebirth / authority / life-cycle / Zeta production residue
L6_BIRTHDAY_IDENTITY.current_reading: English CG02 wording is lexical authority. Rebirth, father/authority, larva-pupa-worker, steel honeycomb, 10 within 101, aging/soul/incineration form a dense identity/life-cycle artifact. Zeta birthday residue is a production parallel, not proof of Zetan birth orchestration.
L6_BIRTHDAY_IDENTITY.next_test: rare-cluster full-corpus recurrence + matched narrative null + exact asset lineage controls

L7_ATOMIC_FALLOUT.label: Children of Atom universe-splitting doctrine
L7_ATOMIC_FALLOUT.current_reading: Fallout turns division into creation/multiplicity. This is a theological/narrative claim inside the fiction.

L8_QUANTUM_BRANCHING.label: fission / entanglement / environment / decoherence / Everett
L8_QUANTUM_BRANCHING.current_reading: Fission is quantum dynamics; environment coupling and decoherence generate robust records/effective classical histories. Everett is one interpretation of this branch structure. No direct observation here establishes one atom -> one separate classical universe.

L9_ENVIRONMENTAL_PERSISTENCE.label: isotope/radionuclide/radiocarbon and other long-lived records
L9_ENVIRONMENTAL_PERSISTENCE.current_reading: Nuclear events can produce persistent physical records that alter the subsequent measurable history of environment and biology. This is the strongest real-world 'event leaves a history' bridge.

L10_UAP_EMPIRICAL.label: nuclear context vs UAP/transient association
L10_UAP_EMPIRICAL.current_reading: Historical JANUS Bayesian values are versioned assumption-conditional outputs. Palomar-related evidence is contested and must be reproduced with observation exposure and artifact controls before updating claims.

L11_SIMULATION_BRANCHING.label: save/load/modding as software branching
L11_SIMULATION_BRANCHING.current_reading: Game states provide a literal software example of alternative histories, useful pedagogically but not physically equivalent to quantum decoherence.

L12_MEMORY_PSYCHOLOGY.label: autobiographical memory, belief, recollection, confidence, false-memory controls
L12_MEMORY_PSYCHOLOGY.current_reading: Human-memory research supplies vocabulary and controls for narrative analysis; it does not diagnose Fallout characters or prove Vault112 technology.

L13_EMULATION.label: synthetic event -> record -> observer experiments
L13_EMULATION.current_reading: Emulation can quantify false correlations caused by sampling, exposure, rare-event selection and detector thresholds; it does not summon/instantiate unknown observers.

L14_CULTURAL_ATOM.label: atomic division as cultural world-making/destruction metaphor
L14_CULTURAL_ATOM.current_reading: Children of Atom sits inside a broader human pattern of interpreting atomic power through creation/destruction/rebirth metaphors; cultural recurrence is not physical validation.
